integrity: Mathematical proof and a finite exact-rational checker are provided. Source precedence is not guaranteed; the review is not an independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: All-size theorem is for fully occupied K_{n,n} with n agents of each of two colors, one common closed-neighborhood single-peaked utility, and strict bilateral exchange. It does not address asymmetric parts, color imbalances, heterogeneous tastes, vacancies or the number of random selection attempts.
title: A three-regime equilibrium and exact convergence law for balanced single-peaked Schelling swaps
